meaning: sour, sweet, bitter, hot; all the joys and sorrows of life

senses.en: sour, sweet, bitter, hot; all the joys and sorrows of life

note: Idiom for the full range of experiences in life.

examples.zh: 生活里有酸甜苦辣，都是经历。
examples.en: Life has all its flavors, and every one is an experience.

examples.zh: 他在国外工作多年，尝过酸甜苦辣。
examples.en: He has worked abroad for years and has known life's ups and downs.

examples.zh: 这本书写了一家人的酸甜苦辣。
examples.en: This book tells of one family's joys and sorrows.

meaning: to close (a meeting, event, show); the curtain falls

senses.en: to close (a meeting, event, show); the curtain falls

note: Opposite of 开幕. Used for conferences, games, festivals.

examples.zh: 会议明天下午闭幕。
examples.en: The meeting closes tomorrow afternoon.

examples.zh: 比赛闭幕以后，我们一起吃饭吧。
examples.en: After the competition closes, let's have a meal together.

examples.zh: 运动会什么时候闭幕？
examples.en: When does the sports meet close?

note: Adverb-like before a verb: 慌忙 + verb; suggests panic or rush.

examples.zh: 听到电话响，他慌忙跑过去。
examples.en: Hearing the phone ring, he rushed over.

examples.zh: 她慌忙把手机放在包里。
examples.en: She hurriedly put her phone in her bag.

examples.zh: 看见经理进来，大家慌忙站起来。
examples.en: Seeing the manager come in, everyone scrambled to stand up.

note: Verb-object; 救灾 + 物资/工作.

examples.zh: 很多志愿者去了救灾现场。
examples.en: Many volunteers went to the disaster relief site.

examples.zh: 政府正在组织救灾工作。
examples.en: The government is organizing disaster relief work.

examples.zh: 我们公司给了钱，支持救灾。
examples.en: Our company donated money to support disaster relief.

meaning: both banks of a river; both sides of the Taiwan Strait

senses.en: both banks of a river; both sides of the Taiwan Strait

note: Context decides: a river's 两岸, or 海峡两岸 for Taiwan and the mainland.

examples.zh: 河的两岸都是绿色的树。
examples.en: Both banks of the river are lined with green trees.

examples.zh: 船慢慢开过去，两岸的风景很美。
examples.en: The boat moved slowly on, and the scenery on both banks was lovely.

examples.zh: 两岸的专家都来参加会议。
examples.en: Experts from both sides all came to the meeting.

examples.zh: 图书馆的阅览室很安静。
examples.en: The library's reading room is very quiet.

examples.zh: 请在阅览室里小声说话。
examples.en: Please speak quietly in the reading room.

examples.zh: 学校新开了一间阅览室。
examples.en: The school has opened a new reading room.

note: 一 服 中药 is one dose (one day's portion); 西药 is Western medicine.

examples.zh: 医生给我开了中药，让我每天喝。
examples.en: The doctor prescribed me Chinese medicine to take every day.

examples.zh: 中药有点儿苦，你喝完吃块糖吧。
examples.en: Chinese medicine is a bit bitter; eat a sweet after you drink it.

examples.zh: 你平时喝中药吗？
examples.en: Do you usually take Chinese medicine?

meaning: to play (a role), have (an effect); used with 作用

senses.en: to play (a role), have (an effect); used with 作用

note: Pattern: 起到 + (adj.) + 作用 / 效果.

examples.zh: 运动对健康起到了很大作用。
examples.en: Exercise has played a big role in health.

examples.zh: 这个办法起到作用了吗？
examples.en: Did this method have any effect?

examples.zh: 好的建议能起到很好的作用。
examples.en: Good advice can be very helpful.

note: Used for books, software, music, videos.

examples.zh: 我买的是正版书，价格有点儿贵。
examples.en: I bought the genuine edition, and it's a bit pricey.

examples.zh: 请支持正版，别在网上下载。
examples.en: Please support legitimate copies; don't download from the web.

examples.zh: 这个软件是正版的吗？
examples.en: Is this software legitimate?

examples.zh: 闭幕式在晚上八点开始。
examples.en: The closing ceremony starts at eight in the evening.

examples.zh: 你去看运动会的闭幕式了吗？
examples.en: Did you go to see the sports meet's closing ceremony?

examples.zh: 闭幕式上，大家唱了一首歌。
examples.en: At the closing ceremony, everyone sang a song.

meaning: soy or bean products (tofu, soy milk, etc.)

senses.en: soy or bean products (tofu, soy milk, etc.)

note: A general term; tofu and soy milk are examples.

examples.zh: 豆腐是一种豆制品。
examples.en: Tofu is a kind of soy product.

examples.zh: 医生说我可以多吃一些豆制品。
examples.en: The doctor says I can eat more soy products.

examples.zh: 这家超市的豆制品种类很多。
examples.en: This supermarket has many kinds of soy products.

examples.zh: 请给我一个脸盆，我想洗脸。
examples.en: Please give me a basin; I want to wash my face.

examples.zh: 他把衣服放在脸盆里洗。
examples.en: He put the clothes in the basin to wash them.

examples.zh: 这个脸盆太小了，有大一点儿的吗？
examples.en: This basin is too small; do you have a bigger one?

examples.zh: 爷爷喜欢用毛笔写字。
examples.en: Grandpa likes to write with a brush.

examples.zh: 我想买一支毛笔。
examples.en: I want to buy a writing brush.

examples.zh: 用毛笔写字不容易，要多练习。
examples.en: Writing with a brush isn't easy; you need to practice a lot.

examples.zh: 这本书有电子版吗？
examples.en: Does this book have an electronic edition?

examples.zh: 请把电子版发到我的邮箱。
examples.en: Please send the digital copy to my email.

examples.zh: 合同的电子版我已经发给你了。
examples.en: I've already sent you the digital copy of the contract.

examples.zh: 我们厂长明天要来检查。
examples.en: Our factory director is coming to inspect tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他是这家工厂的厂长。
examples.en: He is the director of this factory.

examples.zh: 请问，厂长在办公室吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, is the director in the office?

examples.zh: 北方冬天很冷，你要带羽绒服。
examples.en: Winter in the north is cold; you should bring a down jacket.

examples.zh: 我想买一件黑色的羽绒服。
examples.en: I want to buy a black down jacket.

examples.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又暖和。
examples.en: This down jacket is light and warm.

examples.zh: 中秋节的时候，我们吃月饼。
examples.en: At the Mid-Autumn Festival we eat mooncakes.

examples.zh: 这盒月饼是朋友送的。
examples.en: This box of mooncakes was a gift from a friend.

examples.zh: 这种月饼太甜了，我吃不了。
examples.en: This kind of mooncake is too sweet; I can't eat it.

examples.zh: 我用电饭锅做饭。
examples.en: I cook with a rice cooker.

examples.zh: 这个电饭锅坏了，要买新的。
examples.en: This rice cooker is broken; we need a new one.

examples.zh: 宿舍里可以用电饭锅吗？
examples.en: Can we use a rice cooker in the dorm?

meaning: Mid-Autumn Festival (15th of the 8th lunar month)

senses.en: Mid-Autumn Festival (15th of the 8th lunar month)

note: Families reunite and eat mooncakes under the full moon.

examples.zh: 中秋节你回家吗？
examples.en: Are you going home for the Mid-Autumn Festival?

examples.zh: 中秋节的晚上，一家人一起看月亮。
examples.en: On Mid-Autumn night the family watches the moon together.

examples.zh: 马上就要到中秋节了。
examples.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is almost here.

note: Verb-object, so "出了很多汗" splits it.

examples.zh: 天太热，我一直在出汗。
examples.en: It's so hot that I keep sweating.

examples.zh: 跑步以后，我出汗了。
examples.en: After running, I was sweating.

examples.zh: 吃了药，你会出汗，这是正常的。
examples.en: After taking the medicine you may sweat; that's normal.
